list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this guide was written. Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; every guide below is written in our own words for this guide.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself: earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops. There is nothing extra to do for it, so follow the five-stage roadmap in this guide — story first, then side strands, activities, open-world feats and collectibles, and finally the 100% completion clean-up. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story mission of the game. It cannot be missed in the sense that the story must pass through it, but it is a one-time story moment, so keep a separate save before you start it until the trophy pops. If mission replay is available, a replay also counts — to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 until the chapter closes. Chapters end when their last mission is done, so just keep following the story markers; there is no side requirement. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 2 until the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies, this one is unmissable as long as you finish the story — it pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 3 until the chapter closes. Keep pushing the story markers; the trophy pops at the end of the chapter's final mission. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 4 until the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it pops as the story moves into its final mission. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. This is the gold trophy for completing the game: play Chapters 1 to 4 to the end and the final mission will unlock. It pops when the mission — and the credits that follow it — are done. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a single named mission, so treat it as a one-time moment: keep a separate save before you start it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. If mission replay is available, replaying the mission also counts — to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in this series are usually single attempts in the story, so keep a separate save before the mission and only overwrite it once the trophy pops. If mission replay is available, a replay also counts — to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is a single named mission, so keep a separate save before you start it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. If mission replay is available, replaying the mission also counts — to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a single named mission, so keep a separate save before you start it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. If mission replay is available, replaying the mission also counts — to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is a single named mission, so keep a separate save before you start it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. If mission replay is available, replaying the mission also counts — to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a single named mission, so keep a separate save before you start it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. If mission replay is available, replaying the mission also counts — to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% in the game's completion tracker. That means the story, the stranger and contact strands, the collectibles and the activities all done — the same work as the rest of this guide, finished. Leave this trophy for last: check the in-game stats screen for what is still missing, clear it piece by piece, and this gold pops with the final item. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, long air time and the like, as the game counts them. The count builds up across the whole playthrough, so do not grind it early: drive fast, take ramps and jumps whenever you see them, and check the in-game stats to see how far along you are. It pops at 250. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game at least once. The official description does not list the types, and the full list of nine is to be confirmed at launch — expect the usual set (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races, hunting and similar). Sample each one as you meet it and the trophy pops when the last type is tried. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — PSNProfiles lists the target as 42 challenges. Go to a shooting range, work through the challenges one weapon at a time, and replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it is gold. Take your time and aim for accuracy over speed; the gold thresholds are per challenge, so a slow clean run beats a fast messy one. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list (42 challenges); Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every race location — PSNProfiles lists the target as 14 locations. Find each drone race spot around Leonida, win one race there, and move on to the next. You only need one win per location, so learn each course's corners on a practice run, then race it for real. Exact race locations are to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list (14 locations); Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: winning the same race twice counts once, so spread your wins across race types and locations — street races, off-road, boat and air races where the game offers them. Keep a note of which races you have already won; the trophy pops on the twentieth distinct win. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing contact you meet through the story and side activities; take his challenge and out-fish him — a bigger catch, or more fish, depending on how the challenge scores it. The exact trigger for Cal's challenge is to be confirmed at launch; fish whenever the option appears so you are ready when it does. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, start a game and play it to its end — a high score is not needed, completion is. If the first game you try is a long one, pick a short cabinet game instead; any completed game counts. The exact cabinet locations are to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Contact strands unlock as you play the story and meet Andy in the world; keep answering his calls and jobs until no more appear, then the final mission unlocks. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Work through Kenton's jobs as they appear, and the strand closes with one last mission — finish it and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy's mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Billy's jobs appear as you explore and progress; keep taking them until the final one unlocks, then finish it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as map markers and chance encounters in the open world; talk to them, take their jobs, and follow each strand to its end. You need eight complete strands, not eight single missions, so stick with each stranger until their story closes. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Follow Randy's mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Work through Randy's jobs as they appear, and the strand closes with one last mission — finish it and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Work through Tyrone's jobs as they appear, and the strand closes with one last mission — finish it and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida — PSNProfiles lists the target as 18 spots. Find each spot, sit down and meditate until the game registers it, then move on. Spots are scattered across the state, so check them off as you travel for other trophies. Exact spot locations are to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list (18 spots); Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting strand points you at a single special animal — follow his directions, track it, and take it down. The animal's exact location is to be confirmed at launch; bring a scoped weapon and approach quietly so it does not bolt before you get a shot. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any three collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way places — and each set needs every card in it. Collect as you explore, check your collection screen to see which sets are nearly done, and finish three sets to pop the trophy. Card locations are to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo or check-in style feature — use it at a new spot and it counts; reuse the same spot and it does not. Work it into your travels: whenever you reach a new area, WAiNK It before you leave. The trophy pops at the hundredth distinct location. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks — driving, shooting, exploring and more — and they tick off as you play normally. Open the challenges screen, pick off the easy ones first, and the trophy pops at 50. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Get the police after you — four stars means helicopters and roadblocks — then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the stars to clear while your partner is still with you. Alleys, tunnels and water help; do not let your partner get separated mid-chase. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route past three close-together shops, rob the first, move straight to the next while the cops are still on you, and repeat. The hard part is keeping the wanted level alive — do not hide or escape until the third shop is done. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles — drive or enter a hundred different models and the game logs each new one. Variety is what counts, so grab every unfamiliar car, bike, boat and plane you pass instead of sticking to one favourite. The in-game stats or vehicle list shows your count; the trophy pops at 100. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with at least five enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain your shots before it runs out. Pick a mission or shootout with clustered enemies, use a fast accurate weapon, and do not waste the window reloading. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport by an unscheduled route — in plain terms, get out of the airport in a way the airport did not plan for. The exact method is to be confirmed at launch; the likeliest paths are stealing a plane and taking off, or driving out through a runway or service exit. Try the plane first: get airside, board a plane, and take off. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tank: the description is a joke, not an instruction, so the exact trigger is to be confirmed at launch. The likeliest reading is surviving or causing mayhem around a Rhino — for example, reaching a wanted level that brings tanks out, or driving one. Raise your wanted level in the open and see what the game counts, and check the in-game stats for a Rhino-related counter. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone detecting you. Go in quiet: avoid the guards' line of sight, stay out of camera view, take what you need and leave before an alarm sounds. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, lose the heat, and try again with a slower approach. The exact store location is to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a planned job: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash, and break away from the police before the escape counts. You do not need to do all five in a row — one at a time is fine — but every one needs a clean escape. Vault locations are to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck, then escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city — spot one, stop it, crack it open, take the cash, and lose the police. A sticky approach is to block the truck with your own vehicle, then break away fast once the money is yours. One truck and one clean escape is all it takes. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every area of Leonida — PSNProfiles lists the target as 52 areas. The game counts an area once you have set foot in it, so drive, fly and sail across the whole map, including the small towns and the far corners of the state. Check the map for unexplored regions and sweep them last; the trophy pops when the final area registers. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list (52 areas); Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each gang in the game — PSNProfiles lists the target as 9 gangs. Illegal operations are the gangs' off-the-books sites around the map; hit one per gang, and the trophy pops when the last gang's operation is done. The exact operation locations are to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list (9 gangs); Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot overlooking Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or venue on Ocean Beach with a sea view, order a cocktail, and enjoy it — the game counts the drink plus the view, so make sure you are on the beachfront, not inland. The exact venue is to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight out of a showroom, smashing through its front in classic style. Get a car inside a vehicle showroom, point it at the glass, and floor it. The exact showroom is to be confirmed at launch — any showroom with a breakable front should count. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, start a game and bowl — follow-through is the key word, so finish your throw properly rather than quitting mid-game. One completed game at this alley should do it; the exact alley location is to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This description is deliberately vague, so the exact trigger is to be confirmed at launch. It points at something you do with your partner that wins a crowd over — most likely a partner activity that draws attention, such as a public stunt or a shared moment the game scores for style. Try the partner activities as they unlock and watch for a mass-appeal moment. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — PSNProfiles tracks a count towards 500 choices for this trophy. Every dialogue pick, story decision and branching choice counts, so do not rush past conversations: pick an option every time one appears and the count climbs. Some choices are one-time story decisions, so keep a separate save before big story choices until this trophy pops — the missable risk here is a choice you cannot take back. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list (500 choices); Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something — the trophy's name says it plainly. The exact trigger is to be confirmed at launch, but the shape of it is clear: fail an attempt at a challenge or activity, then succeed on the very next try. Do not reload an old save after failing, or the second attempt never happens; retry in place and win it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a weird event in the world, most likely a random encounter or easter egg. The exact event is to be confirmed at launch; keep exploring odd corners of the map and take every strange encounter seriously when one appears. It will probably pop when you least expect it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing your melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect — the target needs to go down from the hit. Pick a quiet street, a slow speed and a clear swing so you do not miss and drive on. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and jobs; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs — it is cumulative, so it does not need to be done in one go. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food, anything the shops sell. It is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so normal buying counts and it builds up on its own. If you are short near the end, buy an expensive vehicle or weapon to close the gap. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game — PSNProfiles lists the target as 8 garages. Garages cost money, so save up and buy each one as you can afford it; the trophy pops when the last garage is yours. Garage locations and prices are to be confirmed at launch. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list (8 garages); Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat with nine more distinct vehicles. Any ten count — use cheap, easy-to-find vehicles for the first few, then register rarer ones as you discover them. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list; Rockstar Games GTA VI page.
trophies.name: On the Spot
